notes: The second and third clauses write no interrogative and no negative in Hebrew, so the ASV's repeated Doth/doth/shall and not/not/not are rule 25's distributed realizations of the single הֲ and לֹא of the first clause, each headed on the first occurrence.
The shall of the third clause carries the imperfect's future as well as the question, and rule 17 still gives it to the particle.
In the first colon the one written he was given to the explicit הוּא and only that to the participle; where the ASV writes two he's, as in the second colon, each morpheme takes one.
The margin's Or, this man was read and set aside under rule 38.
